questions.content: Câu 1: Rewrite the sentence without changing the meaning. Mike graduated with a good degree. However, he joined the ranks of the unemployed.
options: A. Mike joined ranks of the unemployed because he graduated with a good degree.
B. If Mike graduated with a good degree, he would joined the ranks of the unemployed.
C. Although Mike graduated with a good degree, he joined the ranks of the unemployed.
D. That Mike graduated with a good degree helped him joined the ranks of the unemployed.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Cấu trúc Although + S + V, S + V diễn tả sự tương phản giữa hai mệnh đề. Dịch nghĩa: Mặc dù Mike tốt nghiệp với tấm bằng giỏi, anh ấy vẫn thất nghiệp.

questions.content: Câu 2: Rewrite the sentence without changing the meaning. Ann always keeps up with the latest fashions. She works for a famous fashion house.
options: A. Ann always keeps up with the latest fashions so as not to work for a famous fashion house.
B. Ann works for a famous fashion house, so she always keeps up with the latest fashions.
C. Not working for a famous fashion house, Ann always keeps up with the latest fashions.
D. Despite working for a famous fashion house, Ann hardly keeps up with the latest fashions.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Cấu trúc so ... that / so + S + V chỉ nguyên nhân – kết quả. Dịch nghĩa: Ann làm việc cho một hãng thời trang nổi tiếng, nên cô ấy luôn cập nhật xu hướng mới nhất.

questions.content: Câu 3: Rewrite the sentence without changing the meaning. They drove fifteen miles off the main road. Also, they had nothing to eat for the day.
options: A. Not only did they drive fifteen miles off the main road, they also had nothing to eat for the day.
B. Driving fifteen miles off the main road, they eventually had nothing to eat for the day.
C. They neither drove fifteen miles off the main road nor had anything to eat for the day.
D. They drove fifteen miles off the main road until they had something to eat for the day.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Cấu trúc Not only did + S + V ... but also + S + V ... dùng để nhấn mạnh hai hành động xảy ra song song. Dịch nghĩa: Họ không chỉ lái xe xa 15 dặm khỏi đường chính mà còn không có gì để ăn suốt cả ngày.

questions.content: Câu 4: Rewrite the sentence without changing the meaning. Put your coat on. You will get cold.
options: A. You will not get cold unless you put your coat on.
B. Put your coat on, otherwise you will get cold.
C. It is not until you put your coat on that you will get cold.
D. You will not only put your coat on but also get cold.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Otherwise = nếu không thì → diễn tả mệnh đề điều kiện ngược lại. Dịch nghĩa: Mặc áo khoác vào, nếu không bạn sẽ bị lạnh.

questions.content: Câu 5: Rewrite the sentence without changing the meaning. Everyone was watching the little dog. They were greatly amused at it.
options: A. Everyone felt great and amused when the little was watching them.
B. The little dog was watching everyone with great amusement.
C. Everyone was greatly amused at the little dog they were watching.
D. The little dog was greatly amused by the way everyone was watching it.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: Kết hợp hai câu có cùng chủ ngữ bằng cách lược bỏ đại từ lặp lại và dùng mệnh đề quan hệ rút gọn. Dịch nghĩa: Mọi người rất thích thú khi xem chú chó nhỏ mà họ đang nhìn.

questions.content: Câu 6: Rewrite the sentence without changing the meaning. Mary did not put any effort into learning English. She cannot speak with foreign partners in this project now.
options: A. Even Mary put great effort into learning English, she cannot speak with the foreign partners in this project now.
B. Mary did not put any effort into learning English, but she can speak with the foreign partners in this project now.
C. Although Mary did not put any effort into learning English, she couldn't speak with the foreign partners in this project.
D. If Mary had put her effort into learning English, she could speak with the foreign partners in this project now.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: D Giải thích: Cấu trúc điều kiện loại 3 – loại 2 kết hợp (mixed conditional) được dùng khi nói về một hành động không xảy ra trong quá khứ → hậu quả ở hiện tại. Công thức: If + had + P.P, S + could/would + V (bare-infinitive). Dịch nghĩa: Nếu Mary đã cố gắng học tiếng Anh, bây giờ cô ấy có thể nói chuyện với các đối tác nước ngoài trong dự án này.

questions.content: Câu 7: Rewrite the sentence without changing the meaning. My younger sister was so excited to learn new things after work. She is in a cake-baking class now.
options: A. My younger sister wasn't so excited to learn new things after work, so she was in a cake-baking class now.
B. If my younger sister hadn't been so excited to learn new things after work, she would not be in a cake-baking class now.
C. My younger sister wasn't so excited to learn new things after work, so she wasn't in a cake-baking class now.
D. My sister wasn't in a cake-baking class now because she wasn't excited to learn new things after work.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Câu điều kiện hỗn hợp loại 3 + 2 (past → present). Hành động quá khứ: cô ấy rất hào hứng học cái mới → kết quả hiện tại: cô ấy đang học làm bánh. Cấu trúc: If + had + P.P, S + would + V (bare-infinitive). Dịch nghĩa: Nếu em gái tôi đã không hào hứng học những điều mới sau giờ làm, thì bây giờ cô ấy đã không học lớp làm bánh.

questions.content: Câu 8: Rewrite the sentence without changing the meaning. My dad had a wide range of practical life skills. He could solve most problems by himself.
options: A. If my dad hadn't had a wide range of practical life skills, he couldn't have solved most problems by himself.
B. Because my dad hadn't had a wide range of practical life skills, he couldn't have solved most problems by himself.
C. Since my dad didn't have a wide range of practical life skills, he couldn't solve most problems by himself.
D. If my dad had a wide range of practical life skills, he couldn't solve most problems by himself.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: Câu điều kiện loại 3 dùng để diễn tả giả định trái ngược với quá khứ. Cấu trúc: If + had + P.P, S + could/would + have + P.P. Dịch nghĩa: Nếu bố tôi không có nhiều kỹ năng sống thực tế, ông ấy đã không thể tự giải quyết hầu hết các vấn đề.
